newsitem.title: FRANCE: Freight flights rise at Paris airports in Jan 1997.
newsitem.headline: Freight flights rise at Paris airports in Jan 1997.

text.p: The number of freighter flights operating at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly, in January 1997 totalled 1,788, an increase of 22.2 percent on the same month the previous year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.
Freighter flights operating at CDG in January totalled 1,646, an increase of 26.8 percent on January 1996.
The number of freighter flights operating at Orly airport fell by 13.9 percent to 142 flights in January.

Full-freighter flights accounted for 3.5 percent of global flights operating at the Paris airports in January 1997, compared to 3.1 percent in the corresponding month the previous year. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
